## Diverging Signals

- **Oil fell 7.79% while war headlines rose.** The two do not fit together. Either the escalation is not yet priced into crude, or the oil drop reflects demand fear. It could not be resolved with this data.
- **Put/call fell to 0.81 on a −10% day.** Falling hedging demand during a crash is unusual. It could mean traders were already positioned for the fall, or that call buyers are bidding the dip.
- **RSI 27.4 is oversold, but the trend is still down.** The RSI says stretched. Price is still under every moving average. Oversold can persist.
